content.title: Frontdoor (NASDAQ:FTDR) Exceeds Q3 Expectations
content.summary: Home warranty company Frontdoor (NASDAQ:FTDR) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 14.4% year on year to $618 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $420 million at the midpoint, 0.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.58 per share was 4.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
